title: NEW People 1st Realty Group Website
description:
Welcome to the NEW People 1st Realty Group Website!

Hello everyone and welcome! 👋
Today, we want to take you on a quick guided tour through our valuable real estate resources — all available on our brand-new People 1st Realty Group website.
Whether you're a buyer, seller, investor, or just curious about real estate in Texas and beyond, there’s something here for you! 🏡

✨ Here’s what you’ll find inside:
🔸 Buyer Tools: Quick and advanced property searches, mortgage calculators, and first-time buyer tips.
🔸 Seller Resources: Free home valuation, profit estimators, and a full library of past listings to show how we market homes.
🔸 Certified Divorce Real Estate Section: Learn how our CDRE services help clients navigate real estate transitions with clarity and care.
🔸 Community Spotlights: Explore homes by area — Austin, Temple, Killeen, and beyond — each with its own unique style and lifestyle options.
🔸 Relocation & Military Families: Access relocation guides, moving tips, and area insights for your next move.
🔸 Video Gallery: Watch helpful videos on buying, selling, and maintaining your home — all in one place!
At People 1st Realty Group, we’re here to make your real estate journey simpler, smarter, and more personal.
Take a moment to explore and see how we can help you today:

We look forward to connecting with you soon!
— Gloria Watson, Broker Associate | People 1st Realty Group
